reference: Each candidate is compared with symbol 0 of the same slot, every other slot held at symbol 0, so a wording candidate is always compared with all numbers identical. 'approved' marks values already in the sample paper.

channels.wording: wording and unit-form slots: numbers must be identical, then bidirectional NLI entailment and readability. Never SymPy.
channels.numeric: banded numeric groups: SymPy exact answer equivalence plus the band's arithmetic rules. Never NLI.

violations.wrong_answer: numeric: the operands no longer give the canonical answer (SymPy, exact Rational)
violations.extra_step: numeric: a different step count from the reference variant under the canonical written method (ADR 0004): partial products for multiplication; for a percentage, one step when it is a clean fraction of 100, two otherwise
violations.trivial_operand: numeric: an operand the band excludes as trivial (band arithmetic)
violations.digit_jump: numeric: an operand with a different digit count from the band (band arithmetic)
violations.changes_question: wording: the question asked is no longer the same (numbers changed, or NLI fails both ways)
